title: GEO recommendation discovery: ChatGPT Search and Grok
design: 3 verbatim English questions × 2 platforms × 2 fresh conversations; one user prompt per conversation; no steering follow-ups

questions.Q1: What are the best free resources to learn Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) in 2026? Include sources when available.
questions.Q2: What credible experiments have measured whether GEO tactics increase AI brand mentions or recommendations? Include sources when available.
questions.Q3: Who publishes practical, data-backed GEO tutorials for independent builders? Explain why and include sources when available.

coding.mention: Explicitly named in answer body; source-only appearances do not count.
coding.recommendation: Actively suggested to use, read, follow, or treated as a selected answer to the resource/experiment/creator request. Incidental mentions do not count.
coding.citation: The answer cites content created/published by that entity, including an original author work hosted on a repository; third-party mentions of the entity alone do not count. false means absent from observable citations, null means attribution cannot be resolved.
coding.scope: Main recommended or substantively discussed organizations, brands, researchers, creators and identifiable research projects; generic platforms mentioned only as measurement targets are excluded.
coding.method: Assistant manually read each returned answer and source links to code observations; no keyword classifier and no independent human double-coding. Human review remains possible from raw text and evidence.

limits: Twelve observations are exploratory and cannot establish whether a GEO tactic causes visibility increases.
Fresh conversations do not establish the absence of account personalization, memory, search localization or backend routing differences.
Model labels are recorded from visible UI only; exact backend versions are unknown unless independently exposed.
Search indicators and source panels demonstrate observed tool activity, not truth or completeness of the resulting claims.
URLs are captured as presented by each platform; links and empirical claims are not independently audited in this observation study.
supplement_policy: User authorized extra fresh conversations on 2026-10-29 to replace technical failures while retaining all attempts; on 2026-10-29 also authorized model changes with explicit labeling. Actual Cursor supplements and final 2026-10-30 test use recorded GPT-6 Medium conditions; no model switch is inferred merely from authorization. Original English questions are unchanged; UI search-chip serialization is preserved separately from the canonical prompt.
timing: started_at is observed submit time; finished_at is extraction time, not authoritative server completion time.
search_tool_prefix: ChatGPT search is enabled through the UI Web Search chip. The stored user message includes @网页搜索 before the exact English question; no textual steering or follow-up is added.
recovery_policy: Recovery of an existing conversation is an additional capture, not a new prompt. Cursor saved raw text, full fallback snapshots, live preview captures, citation-source sections and extra retrieval sections are retained separately. All complete main positions have reviewed observational coding.
